queries.query: large language model "network configuration" generation intent-to-configuration NetOps
queries.rationale: Locate primary work where LLMs translate operator intent or NL to device/config snippets; establishes direct prior art for generative NetOps tasks.
Find papers and systems that use LLMs to detect and repair misconfigurations or iteratively fix outputs using validators.

queries.query: verifier-assisted LLM network configuration Batfish SMT "formal verification" NetKAT Header Space Analysis
queries.rationale: Identify integration of formal/deterministic network verifiers with ML/LLM layers (architectures combining symbolic verification and generation).

queries.query: AIOps LLM network operations autonomous agentic workflow "network"
queries.rationale: Survey work framing LLMs/agents for AIOps/NetOps workflows, orchestration, and autonomous remediation to understand agentic designs and safety concerns.

queries.query: benchmarks "LLM for networking" "NetOps benchmark" "network configuration" dataset evaluation
queries.rationale: Find existing benchmarks and datasets for LLMs in networking or AIOps to assess evaluation gaps and reproducibility practices.

queries.query: operational correctness metrics network configuration verification reachability policy compliance "evaluation metrics"
queries.rationale: Discover operationally meaningful metrics (reachability, isolation, policy compliance, performance regressions) that should be used when evaluating generative NetOps outputs.
Search for threat models and attack classes (prompt injection, adversarial examples, malicious specs) relevant to deploying LLMs in NetOps.
Find techniques to constrain LLM outputs (templates, schemas, type checkers, execution sandboxes) applicable to safe NetOps generation.

queries.query: generate-validate-repair pipeline "LLM" "tool feedback" verification loop "network change"
queries.rationale: Locate architectural patterns where generation is paired with automated validation and repair loops; assess success criteria and failure modes.

queries.rationale: Identify testbeds and simulators used for executing or validating network configs produced by ML models to ground operational evaluation.
Search for methods enabling traceable rationales, provenance, or human-auditable explanations for generated network actions/configs.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop verification "network change" LLM review operator acceptance change-management
queries.rationale: Find studies on human–AI collaboration for validating and approving network changes to understand practical mitigation strategies and UX constraints.

queries.rationale: Collect empirical analyses of real-world misconfigurations/outages to identify common failure modes and which could be impacted by automated LLM workflows.

queries.query: regulatory auditing "network configurations" compliance change logs "audit"
queries.rationale: Survey compliance and audit requirements (logging, provenance) that any autonomous NetOps solution must meet.

queries.query: LLM "code synthesis" repair "program repair" lessons for network configuration automation
queries.rationale: Map analogies from program synthesis and automated code repair literature to network configuration generation/repair to borrow proven methods and evaluation strategies.

queries.query: dataset "network configuration" corpus "network device configuration" public dataset
queries.rationale: Locate available public corpora of device configs, annotated intents, or change logs usable for training/evaluating LLM workflows.
Investigate methodological best practices for evaluating operational AI systems, focusing on reproducibility, pre-registration, and failure reporting.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed conference or journal papers and reputable arXiv preprints relevant to LLMs, NetOps, network verification, AIOps, or automated configuration.
Tool and project documentation (Batfish, NetKAT, Mininet, ns-3) when used as primary evidence for verification or testing methods.
Public datasets, benchmark descriptions, and code repositories that enable reproducible evaluation.
Operator reports and postmortems when primary evidence is available and cited (used to motivate real-world failure modes).
Works describing evaluation metrics, threat models, or mitigation architectures applicable to LLM-driven NetOps.
exclusion_criteria: Non-English sources unless they contain unique primary evidence unavailable elsewhere.
Pure marketing or vendor blog posts that lack primary technical detail or reproducible artifacts (unless they link to verifiable docs/repositories).
Papers that only evaluate generic LLM knowledge quizzes about networking without operational configuration or validation context.
Benchmarks or datasets older than the domain cutoff that are not seminal; exclude outdated model-leaderboard posts unless they include NetOps-relevant artifacts.
Unverifiable claims, missing author/venue metadata, or fabricated bibliographic entries.
date_rationale: Focus primarily on the recent surge of LLM-for-systems literature (roughly 2018–2026) to capture contemporary methods and agentic workflows, while including earlier seminal network-verification and formal-methods work (e.g., Header Space Analysis, NetKAT, Batfish origins) irrespective of date to ground verification comparisons. This balances currency for LLM developments with historical foundations for network verification and operational practice.
